concepts.anchor_rule: Anchor at the midpoint of the supported transition.
concepts.box_rule: Enclose the observed segment and nearby contrasting pixels on both sides.
concepts.definition: A locally near-vertical transition with dark pixels on the left and brighter pixels on the right.

negatives.evidence: The upright bright strip borders black on its right.

positives.evidence: An upright bright strip has black pixels immediately to its left.
Below the curved shoulder, a short near-vertical pale margin borders black on its left.

concepts.support_rule: Require sustained vertical contrast within visible content. Exclude mask edges and do not infer continuation.

concepts.anchor_rule: Anchor at the midpoint of the supported transition.
concepts.box_rule: Enclose the observed transition and local contrast on both sides.
concepts.definition: A locally near-vertical transition with brighter pixels on the left and dark pixels on the right.

negatives.evidence: The bright strip is on the right of the black region.

positives.evidence: A pale upright strip meets black along its right side.
Below the rounded shoulder, the pale right margin becomes approximately upright beside black.

concepts.support_rule: Require a sustained near-vertical segment inside visible content. Exclude mask edges and inferred extensions.

concepts.anchor_rule: Anchor at the supported bend between the upright and rising portions.
concepts.box_rule: Enclose the visible bend and adjacent contrast without completing an outline.
concepts.definition: A curved transition rising toward the right from a near-vertical left margin, with darkness above-left and brighter material below-right.

negatives.evidence: The shoulder descends rightward, with darkness above-right.

positives.evidence: The pale left margin curves upward toward the right beneath black.
A pale margin bends from an upright segment into a boundary rising rightward.

concepts.support_rule: Require visible curvature and the specified sidedness within the window. Cropping does not establish endpoints.

concepts.anchor_rule: Anchor at the supported bend into the upright margin.
concepts.box_rule: Enclose the observed curve and immediate contrast on both sides.
concepts.definition: A curved transition descending toward the right into a near-vertical right margin, with brighter material below-left and darkness above-right.

negatives.evidence: The shoulder rises rightward with darkness above-left.

positives.evidence: The pale upper-right boundary rounds downward toward an upright margin against black.
A pale shoulder descends rightward and bends into a steep right edge.

concepts.support_rule: Require curvature with the specified orientation inside visible content. Exclude mask boundaries and hidden contour completion.

concepts.anchor_rule: Anchor at the midpoint of the supported ridge.
concepts.box_rule: Enclose the ridge and visible context immediately above and below.
concepts.definition: A narrow, approximately horizontal bright ridge along a lighter region's lower boundary, with visibly darker pixels below.

negatives.evidence: The prominent bright boundary is an upper arc with darkness above.

positives.evidence: A bright horizontal ridge runs beneath vertical pale shading, with darker pixels below.
A faint pale horizontal lower ridge separates the shaded region above from a dark band below.

concepts.support_rule: Require a local brightness ridge and lower-side contrast inside the window. Do not infer endpoints or use the window bottom as evidence.

concepts.anchor_rule: Anchor at the midpoint of the supported dark centerline.
concepts.box_rule: Enclose the visible dark segment and its bright lateral flanks.
concepts.definition: A narrow, vertically elongated dark mark with brighter pixels supporting both lateral sides.

negatives.evidence: The broad black area beside the bright strip lacks a bright flank on its left.

positives.evidence: A thin upright black groove lies between pale vertical flanks.
A short vertically elongated dark mark has pale support on both sides near the right margin.

concepts.support_rule: Require vertical elongation and two visible bright flanks. Do not infer closure, depth, or true endpoints.
